serviceOutput: Entity-Relation Extraction Pipeline: Local LLM structured triple extraction from Markdown, PDFs, and web clips.
Canonical Entity Resolution: Deterministic alias tables and semantic deduplication to prevent node fragmentation.
Embedded Property Graph Store: Portable SQLite, NetworkX, KuzuDB, or Neo4j Desktop graph database with temporal edges.
Personal GraphRAG Retriever: Multi-hop neighborhood traversal combined with Leiden community summaries and hybrid vector search.
Provenance & Recovery Tooling: Source-file hash tracking, confidence thresholds, and non-destructive graph rebuild scripts.
